high_level_description: The image shows a notification from the Yahoo Finance app on a smartphone screen. The notification is displayed at the top of the screen and reads: "Yahoo Finance Samsung Elec signs $16.5 billion contract to supply semiconductors." The notification was received 1 hour ago, as indicated in the top right corner. The background of the notification is a gradient of yellow and beige, which contrasts with the white text. The Yahoo Finance logo, featuring a stylized "G" within a blue square, is located to the left of the text. Below the notification, there are two icons.
